chapter_structure.section_ar: الفصل الخامس: العلاقة مع الحكومة والعلاقات الخارجية

verification_methodology_note: Saudi Central Bank Law «نظام البنك المركزي السعودي» — Royal Decree M/36 dated 11/4/1442H (26 November 2020), approved by Council of Ministers Resolution 229 (9/4/1442H) following Shura Council Resolution 1/2 (1/4/1442H), published in the Official Gazette 26/4/1442H, entered into force 90 days after publication per Article 27 (~11 March 2021). Replaces the earlier Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency (SAMA) Law, Royal Decree No. 23, 23/5/1377H, per Article 26. The task-briefing date "11/2/1442H" is confirmed ERRONEOUS -- it is a Bureau of Experts internal drafting-committee memo date cited in the Council of Ministers Resolution's own recitals (memo No. 236, 11/2/1442H), not the Royal Decree's date, which is confirmed 11/4/1442H via four independent means: SAMA's own official PDF signature-page image, a Wayback Machine snapshot of the Bureau of Experts (BOE) portal's law-detail page dated 24 January 2022 (before the 2022 amendment), qistas.com, and ajel.sa. Distinct from the separate Banking Control Law (نظام مراقبة البنوك) -- not conflated. PRIMARY SOURCE A (current/in-force text): SAMA's own official PDF, sama.gov.sa/ar-sa/Documents/SCB_ar.pdf, cross-checked page-by-page against rendered page images (visual inspection) for every article touched by the 2022 amendment, since automated layout-preserving extraction garbled RTL multi-column lettering in Articles 8 and 10. PRIMARY SOURCE B (original, pre-amendment text): the Bureau of Experts law portal, archived via Wayback Machine at a snapshot dated 24 Jan 2022 -- before the sole amending instrument -- a clean HTML extraction including the full Royal Decree preamble and the full Council of Ministers Resolution 229 recitals. laws.boe.gov.sa's LIVE portal returned HTTP 503 on every direct and r.jina.ai-proxied attempt this session; the archived snapshot substituted successfully. SECONDARY CORROBORATION: qistas.com (fragment match, Articles 1-3), nezams.com (chapter/article-count summary), ajel.sa (news summary of the 2022 amendment's six-item scope, independently matched against SAMA PDF footnotes). Two-source agreement achieved for: preamble, chapter titles, all 27 articles' core wording, and both the original and amended states of Articles 8, 11, and 14. NO IRRECOVERABLE GAPS -- every article's full text (current, and for the 3 amended articles, original pre-amendment wording) was recovered from primary sources with independent cross-verification. Articles 15-21 and 23-27 were verified against the two primary sources listed but not independently re-confirmed against a third source. NO DEDICATED IMPLEMENTING REGULATION specific to this law was found as of the build date -- SAMA administers implementing regulations for other, separate laws under its authority (Payment Systems and Services Law, Finance Companies Control Law, Important Financial Institutions Resolution Law), but this self-executing institutional/governance statute does not appear to have its own. The Chapter 2(b) section heading itself was also amended by Resolution 412 (item خامساً): "ب- المحافظ ونائب المحافظ وموظفو البنك" -> "ب- المحافظ ونائبا المحافظ وموظفو البنك" -- this heading-level change is documented here and in chapter_structure, not modeled as its own article record. Two PDF typographic footnote-callout superscript markers (referencing the amendment footnotes printed elsewhere in SAMA's PDF) were stripped from the ingested Article 11 and Article 13-heading text during ingestion -- pure typographic artifacts carrying no phonetic or semantic content, per this corpus's established tatweel/footnote-marker normalization practice; no wording altered.

known_unresolved_discrepancies.description: Article 9 still cross-references subclause "(ج)" of Article 8's paragraph (1) for the five non-government board members, but Council of Ministers Resolution 412 (28/7/1443H) relettered that subclause from (ج) to (ت) when it inserted a new subclause (ب) for the two deputy governors. This is a genuine uncorrected cross-reference left over from the amendment, confirmed via direct visual inspection of SAMA's current official PDF page image -- not an extraction artifact. Preserved verbatim, not corrected.

Article 10's eight sub-items are lettered in classical abjad order (أ ب ج د هـ و ز ح) in the pre-amendment BOE archive text but in plain alphabetical order (أ ب ت ث ج ح خ د) in SAMA's current official PDF. Article 10 was not one of the six items amended by Resolution 412, and the content of each lettered item is identical between the two source revisions -- only the lettering convention differs. Confirmed via direct visual inspection of the rendered PDF page in both source generations, not a text-extraction artifact; appears to be an unannounced typesetting change introduced when SAMA re-issued its PDF. This ingestion uses SAMA's current (alphabetical) lettering as the in-force text. Preserved verbatim, not corrected.

Article 12 still cross-references "الفقرة (2)" of Article 8 for the member-nomination procedure. Before the 2022 amendment this content genuinely was paragraph (2). After Resolution 412 inserted the new "2 مكرر" paragraph (designating a deputy to chair meetings) and renumbered the nomination content to paragraph (3), Article 12's cross-reference to "الفقرة (2)" now points to the wrong (unrelated) paragraph. Confirmed via direct visual inspection of SAMA's current official PDF page image, not an extraction artifact. Preserved verbatim, not corrected.

**تنبيه سريان**: النسخة المُستوعبة هنا منشورة بتاريخ 2020-11-27، وقد رصد تدقيق السريان (scripts/audit_corpus_currency.py) إشعار تعديل واحداً في أرشيف جريدة أم القرى **بعد** هذا التاريخ، يحمل عنوانه اسم هذه الأداة بكل كلماته المميِّزة ونوعها ذاته (نظام): 2022-03-11 — الموافقة على تعديل نظام البنك المركزي السعودي (https://www.uqn.gov.sa/details?p=19094). **الإشعار ليس نص التعديل**، ولذلك لا يُدَّعى هنا شيء عن مضمونه ولم يُعدَّل نص أي مادة استناداً إليه. والمطابقة على العنوان لا على المتن، وقد يَرِد اسم أداة داخل عنوانٍ موضوعُه أداة مجاورة، فالصفحة الرسمية المذكورة هي الفيصل. المُفصَح عنه هو أن نص هذا المسار **قد لا يكون محدَّثاً**. يُرفع هذا التنبيه فقط عند استيعاب النص المعدَّل من مصدر رسمي. (تاريخ الطبعة أعلاه محسوب من التاريخ الهجري المُثبَت في المصدر، لا مقروءاً من ترويسة الجريدة؛ وقد اشتُرط فارق ثلاثين يوماً على الأقل حتى لا يُنتج خطأ التحويل تنبيهاً كاذباً.)
